note: Re-judged after c356b97d17. The P-bit vehicle is still config: externalPropagate (redist_wiring.go) reads the per-source nssa-propagate leaf (config.go, default false); External carries only metric, type and tag, never P. TestNSSAPerSourcePropagationEnabled parses nssa-propagate true for static and asserts P set on the imported route and the default, plus metric 33 and tag 77; TestNSSAPerSourcePropagationDisabled asserts P clear for explicit false (connected) and an unconfigured source (bgp), which is the RFC's P-clear default; TestNSSAPerSourcePropagationCannotOverrideType5 asserts P clear with a Type-5 twin.
